verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a fraud-protection API platform, but every documented endpoint (Sale, Checkout, Get Decision, Chargeback, Representment, guarantee cancellation) works on a single order or event. The evidence shows no batch endpoint, bulk import, or multi-item action. Webhooks and per-order APIs are adjacent features and do not count toward bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
